title: Do not add explicit exit 1 guards to AND-linked YAML execution jobs
abstract: When authoring YAML-specification execution jobs whose runner already AND-links commands and propagates failures, do not insert redundant explicit `exit 1` statements or shell error-exit guards in the YAML commands. Rely on the job's existing command-failure behavior instead.

source.reference: Generalized YAML job error-handling preference; private source wording not retained

scope_hints.trigger: Preparing or modifying an execution job using the established YAML specification with AND-linked commands
scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only YAML job command bodies governed by the existing runner's failure propagation; not a rule to suppress legitimate errors in independent script implementations

unresolved: Confirm the exact YAML runner's AND-linking/error-propagation contract during normalization without inventing alternative failure handling.
Distinguish redundant inline exit statements from legitimate error handling within separately maintained scripts.
remarks: Queued atomic prohibition only; no specimen processing, catalog publication, YAML job execution or unrelated local repository changes are authorized.
